title: eval-harness: add CI prompt-regression gating + metrics integration
author: Asha Patel
description: This PR wires prompt-set regression checks and quality gating into the eval-harness CI pipeline. Motivation: prevent accidental prompt regressions when model updates or prompt edits change quality metrics. Changes include a new GitHub Actions job `eval-harness/regression-gate` that runs a curated prompt set, computes metrics (rouge, exact-match, P0/P1 scoring hooks), and posts gate results to PR checks and Linear. The job supports a fallback evaluation tier for flaky tests, a threshold configuration per-model via eval-configs/, and a metrics export step that integrates with our internal CI metrics endpoint. Checklist: 1) add gating job and matrix for model variants 2) add metric calculators and export hooks 3) add docs and contributor guidance 4) update README and changelog links. This description includes high-level motivation, test plan, and rollout notes.

release_notes: Added CI gating for eval-harness that prevents prompt-set regressions by running a curated prompt suite and failing the gate when configured thresholds regress. Also adds metrics export for CI dashboards and contributor docs on adjusting thresholds.
notes_for_release: Rollout: enabled on main for lightweight model matrix; full matrix rollout opt-in via `GATE_MATRIX` flag. Ops: if the gate fails repeatedly for a model, follow docs/eval-harness/gating.md to create a stability incident and mark prompt set as flaky.
